summary:
Frontend-only verification of the new WatchFirstVideo swap on /prep/child-goals. All targeted acceptance criteria pass: (1) GET /videos/child-goals-reflection.mp4 returns HTTP 200, Content-Type video/mp4, Content-Length 3428473 bytes (matches spec ~3428473). (2) Panel data-testid='child-goals-watch-panel' renders on /prep/child-goals with all four expected sub-testids: -video, -center-play, -toggle-button, -mute-button, -fullscreen-button. Video element has correct src (/videos/child-goals-reflection.mp4), preload='metadata', playsInline=true. (3) Mute + fullscreen + toggle buttons click without throwing. (4) REGRESSION: Selecting 'Emotional safety' then clicking 'Continue: Issues' (data-testid='wizard-next-button') fires PUT /api/mediation/child-goals -> 200, shows 'Your goals are saved.' toast, and navigates to /prep/issues.

One acceptance criterion could NOT be behaviourally verified inside Playwright's Chromium: the HTML5 video failed to decode with error code 4 — 'PipelineStatus::DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS: FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams' — and video.play() rejected with NotSupportedError ('The element has no supported sources'). This is the documented H.264/AAC codec limitation in Playwright's headless Chromium build (chromium ships without proprietary codecs); the agent-to-agent context note in the review request explicitly says NOT to fail the test for this reason and to rely on HEAD + element existence + src correctness — all of which pass. Real browsers (Chrome, Safari, iOS, Firefox on Android) will play libx264+AAC mp4 natively.

panel_render.subtitle_rendered: A moment of reflection — 45 seconds before you begin

playback_in_playwright_chromium.play_promise_rejection: NotSupportedError: The element has no supported sources.
playback_in_playwright_chromium.note: Chromium in Playwright lacks proprietary H.264/AAC codecs. Cannot verify duration ~37s, progress bar advance, or auto-pause-on-unmount behaviorally in this environment. Component code path for the unmount cleanup (useEffect return -> v.pause()) is present and looks correct on inspection.

regression_other_listen_first_panels.note: Not re-verified in this iteration. Iteration_12 (previous) verified /prep/communication, /reflection Write tab, /prep/readiness, and /safety-assessment panels play their respective mp3s. No audio files or ListenFirstButton usages were changed in this iteration (only ChildGoals.jsx swapped ListenFirstButton -> WatchFirstVideo; ListenFirstButton.jsx unchanged). Regression risk is effectively zero for those pages.

issues: Minor copy inconsistency: subtitle says '45 seconds before you begin' but the actual video is ~37 seconds. Consider aligning the copy with the real duration or making the number generic ('a short reflection before you begin').

critical_code_review_comments: WatchFirstVideo.jsx is well-structured (~209 lines), uses refs correctly, cleans up event listeners in useEffect return, and has a separate unmount effect that pauses playback. Good.
WatchFirstVideo.jsx line 82: user-visible error copy uses a curly apostrophe (didn't) — matches existing style but worth flagging if the codebase is standardising on ASCII apostrophes.

WatchFirstVideo.jsx does not implement global playback coordination (a WatchFirst on one route can't know an audio ListenFirstButton on another route is playing) — same limitation as ListenFirstButton, not a regression.

ChildGoals.jsx line 82: subtitle 'A moment of reflection — 45 seconds before you begin' does NOT match the ~37-second actual video length. Suggest updating to '~40 seconds' or dropping the exact number.

Video file /videos/child-goals-reflection.mp4 is 3.4 MB and served with cache-control: no-store,no-cache,must-revalidate. Consider allowing browser caching (e.g., max-age=86400) since the asset is versioned by filename — this will save bandwidth on repeat visits.
action_items: OPTIONAL: reconcile the subtitle copy on ChildGoals.jsx line 82 with the actual video length (~37s, not 45s).
OPTIONAL: consider caching headers for /videos/*.mp4 static assets (currently no-store).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of feature acceptance criteria that are testable in Playwright Chromium pass. The behavioral playback-duration/progress-advance/unmount-pause checks were not runnable due to documented H.264 codec absence in Playwright's Chromium; the review request explicitly permits this fallback.

test_credentials: Not needed for this test — /prep/child-goals is accessible under the guest auto-bootstrap (a guest_xxx@demo.local user is created and signed in on first visit after legal-modal seed).
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded before first page load to bypass legal modal and orientation: sac_legal_ack_v1 = JSON.stringify({version:'v1', at:<isoDate>}), sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1='1', sac_intro_tour_seen_v3_branded='1'. Guest auth is auto-bootstrapped by the app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration added /app/frontend/src/components/WatchFirstVideo.jsx and swapped ListenFirstButton -> WatchFirstVideo in /app/frontend/src/pages/ChildGoals.jsx only. The testid prefix on the swapped panel is 'child-goals-watch' (NOT 'child-goals-listen'). Subtitle copy is a cosmetic mismatch (45s vs 37s actual duration). Playwright chromium cannot play H.264 mp4 — this is by design and not a bug; verify via HEAD + element+src presence only. Legal modal bypass requires sac_legal_ack_v1 as a JSON-stringified object with version='v1', not the string '1'. Guest auto-bootstrap works for /prep/* pages.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no product bugs. One documented environment limitation (Chromium lacks H.264 in Playwright) prevents in-browser playback verification; falls back to HEAD + DOM verification per the reviewer's explicit instruction.
